The posting is at the Tiruvallur District Collectorate. Eligible candidates holding an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar relevant disciplines can apply. content_sections.heading: DCCM Tiruvallur Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordination and synergy among line departments for environmental protection and climate action. Coordination and Documentation of DCCM activities and capacity-building programmes. Documentation of successful climate adaptation and mitigation initiatives. Acting as a link between the Department of Environment and Climate Change at State level and the DCCM at district level. Organising DCCM meetings once every two months and preparation/submission of Minutes of Meeting. Reviewing innovations and existing schemes relating to Environment and Climate Change. Planning upcoming activities and stakeholder engagements. Assisting in organising District Level Climate Resilient Capacity Building Workshops. Preparation and maintenance of files, reports, photographs, videography, expenditure statements and other documentation relating to DCCM Schemes and activities. Perform any other duties assigned in connection with the activities of the District Climate Change Mission.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for the Technical Assistant post under the District Climate Change Mission, Tiruvallur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 10.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy or similar relevant disciplines from a recognised University/Institution, along with basic type writing skills in both Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: The candidate should not have completed 40 years of age as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for this role?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for the Technical Assistant post is ₹22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates may submit their application along with self-attested copies of required documents by email to [email protected], [email protected] or in person to The District Forest Officer, District Forest Office, Tiruvallur Collector office Camps, Tiruvallur-602 001.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and will be called for In-Person Interview and Typing Test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual for a period of 19 months and does not confer any right for regular appointment under the Government.
